verdict.rationale: Working Copy's first-party manual describes a Repository Agent, an AI assistant used through conversation that can browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push. That covers every element of the story, and the homepage separately lists a 'Code Agent' feature. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the agent's workflow and limits (model, permissions, confirmation before push), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent in use.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can direct an AI agent to browse, search, edit, commit, pull, and push in a repository via conversation

citations.quote: Repository Agent is an AI assistant that you interact with through conversation. Ask it to browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push.
